fib: ______ is the case when interest rates fall.
reverse
The reverse is the case when interest rates fall.
______ is an important variable because it is unforeseen and often cannot be completely mitigated because it is often not fully expected.
Systematic or market risk
Systematic or market risk is an important variable because it is unforeseen and often cannot be completely mitigated because it is often not fully expected.
______ is the risk associated with individual assets.
Unsystematic risk
Unsystematic risk is the risk associated with individual assets.
______ is the actual date on which the firm will mail dividend cheques to holders of record.
payment date
The payment date is the actual date on which the firm will mail dividend cheques to holders of record.
______ is the state of nature assumed in these models.
Certainty
Certainty is the state of nature assumed in these models.
______ is an activity the aim of which is to make a particular part or feature of the world easier to understand, define, quantify, visualize, or simulate.
Scientific modelling
Scientific modelling is an activity the aim of which is to make a particular part or feature of the world easier to understand, define, quantify, visualize, or simulate.
______ is the chance that changes in interest rates will adversely affect the value of a security.
Interest rate risk
Interest rate risk is the chance that changes in interest rates will adversely affect the value of a security.
______ are referred to as fixed -income securities because the debt-service obligations of the issuer are fixed.
Bonds
Bonds are referred to as fixed -income securities because the debt-service obligations of the issuer are fixed.
______ are a popular form of investing, used by millions of individual investors.
Common stocks
Common stocks are a popular form of investing, used by millions of individual investors.
______ is a simple and unambiguous measure of investment return over a single period.
holding period return
The holding period return is a simple and unambiguous measure of investment return over a single period.
______ refers to the risk common to all securities i.e. market risk.
Systematic risk
Systematic risk refers to the risk common to all securities i.e. market risk.
______ is a negotiable, long-term debt instrument that carries certain obligations (including the payment of interest and the repayment of principal) on the part of the issuer.
bond
A bond is a negotiable, long-term debt instrument that carries certain obligations (including the payment of interest and the repayment of principal) on the part of the issuer.
______ are the costs of trading in order to change the portfolio weights.
Transaction costs
Transaction costs are the costs of trading in order to change the portfolio weights.
